title: Chapter 29 Killing The Toad
content:
Chapter 29 Killing The Toad

Wang Shuo took a look at the colorful toad, and it was hard to mess with.

And he even felt that the toad had not yet exerted its strength. After all, as a boss, it must have a big move.

Wang Shuo gritted his teeth and nodded, saying, "Okay."

"Okay!"

Wang Yanbing immediately took out an unknown talisman paper from his backpack and slapped it on his strangely shaped sword.

In an instant, a layer of fiery red light ignited on the blade, flickered slightly a few times, and attached to the blade.

He held the handle of the knife with both hands, kicked his feet, leaped into the air, and shouted "Open".

The toad felt pain immediately, and a huge wound opened on its back, blood spilled, and the color of its body became more vivid.

Moreover, its size became huge in a few breaths.

Wang Shuo was as small as an ant in front of it.

I dare not imagine if I would have a chance to escape from its mouth if I was rolled by its tongue.

I can't fight anymore.

The health of the sludge monster leader has been reduced to less than one tenth. As long as the golden warrior strikes twice more, it can kill it.

In order to prevent the sludge monster leader from counterattacking before death.

Wang Shuo hid far away from the two battlefields.

A minute later, the system prompt sounded:

[Your golden warrior killed the sludge monster leader ID: Mud00001 Tubo, you get all attributes +1. ]

[You have upgraded to level 4, and the reward can allocate 1 free attribute point. ]

After receiving the prompt, Wang Shuo patted his chest and finally killed another one.

He looked at the durability of the golden warrior, which had been reduced to 2000.

There is still strength for a fight.

Wang Shuo absolutely dared not participate in the final boss battle.

Once the boss toad rolled him into his mouth, with his current health value, he would definitely have to start a feast.

Let the golden warrior clean up the remaining monsters first.

And Wang Shuo focused on Wang Yanbing's battle.

After the toad exploded, its tongue became unusually thick and hard, and its eyes could emit energy beams.

As a result, Wang Yanbing fell into a hard fight and could only barely dodge, and some parts of his armor were dented.

Soon, the golden-armored warrior also joined the final decisive battle.

In this way, it became a 2-on-1 situation.

Both the golden-armored warrior and Wang Yanbing had the combat power to match the bronze boss.

In terms of combat power, they immediately took the advantage.

The golden-armored warrior attracted firepower from the front, and Wang Yanbing violently output, and the blood volume of the toad dropped quickly.

However, the durability of the golden-armored warrior dropped even faster.

Wang Shuo was secretly anxious in his heart. If the golden-armored warrior was gone, Wang Yanbing alone would probably not be able to defeat the toad.

After fighting for a while, in the flash of lightning, the golden-armored warrior seized an opportunity and cut off the tongue of the toad with a knife.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed, God bless.

The attack power of the toad was weakened by more than half at once.

The HP also dropped to less than 1000, while the durability of the golden armored warrior was still 500.

The balance of victory finally tilted towards Wang Shuo.

Not long after, the bronze toad felt a little defeated and was about to escape.

"Wang Yanbing, we can't let it escape!"

Wang Shuo was very anxious and shouted. He didn't care about hiding now. If he let it run away, he would have to go to the swamp to kill it later, and he would have no advantage.

Wang Yanbing jumped and chopped directly, and the enchanted big knife chopped into the wound again.

The golden armored warrior also used his legs to jump to his back, and did the same action as Wang Yanbing. With one knife, he almost split the boss in half.

Finally, the boss Toad, after struggling for a few times, fell down with a bang, and the system prompt sounded:

[Your puppet killed the level 10 bronze boss, ID frog 00010 Wentai, and you are rewarded with all attributes +3, "terrain change" scrolls × 10, silver treasure chest × 1, delusion-breaking eye skill book, and flaming spear construction drawings. ]

[Since you are the first player to kill the bronze boss, you are rewarded with treasure map fragment (1/3) × 1, void shuttle stone × 1. ]

[You have upgraded to level 5, and the reward can be allocated 1 free attribute point. ]

[System announcement: Player ID: 5678 Wang Shuo, the first to kill the bronze boss, hereby announced. ]

Wang Shuo was relieved until this moment.

The next step is to collect the items dropped by the monsters.

Wang Yanbing stood aside very politely and did not collect the items.

[Energy crystal × 1800, soul × 5, bronze treasure chest × 5, crocodile skin × 160, meat × 460, bones × 200, gold coins × 300]

The leader of the mud monster contributed 2 souls to Wang Shuo, and the bronze toad exploded 3 souls and 5 bronze treasure chests.

Wang Shuo was stunned for a while when he saw such a huge amount of supplies.

After a long time, Wang Shuo came back to his senses and saw Wang Yanbing beside him, and put away his silly expression.

Then he became alert and arranged the golden armor warrior by his side.

"Dear boss, the safety of the employer is our mission. After all, the employment is over. I hope you can give a 5-star rating!"

"Friendly reminder, our employment contract is charged by the hour. There are 20 minutes left. What else can I do for you?"

When Wang Shuo thought of charging by the hour, he felt distressed. One hour means 100 gold coins.

But it is worth it. After all, his life is more precious.

"How much do you want to add?" Wang Shuo was in a good mood at this time. As long as the other party didn't ask for too much, he could accept it.

"Dear boss, you know, the bronze boss just now is not an ordinary boss. In order to deal with it, I consumed a medium-level attack enchantment talisman paper, which is worth 100 gold coins."

He thought for a moment and said, "Just 100 gold coins. After all, your puppet also played a big role in the battle just now."

Wang Shuo's mind was also active at this moment. The mercenary in front of him was a real old player.

It would be great if he could get some important information from him.

"How about this, I will compensate you with 150 gold coins, and we will have a good chat in the remaining time." Wang Shuo rubbed his hands and smiled.

Wang Yanbing glanced at the houses in the distance, and understood what was going on. He asked casually, "Dear boss, are you doing the novice trial? How many days have you survived?"

"Seventh day."

Wang Yanbing was shocked. It was only the seventh day, and there were houses. This was a great start!

But looking around him, it was a swamp. How could this be possible?

He couldn't figure it out, and a bronze boss appeared in his territory, which made him, a veteran and knowledgeable D-level mercenary, stunned.

I have never heard anyone say that a bronze boss will appear in the novice trial.

And he can also obtain a mercenary contract and create a D-level combat puppet like the golden armor warrior.

He was so shocked that he couldn't speak.

Then he became more respectful.

"Dear boss, as long as it doesn't violate the rules of the game, I will tell you everything I know."
